newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania to offer 1.25 trln lei in T-bills in May.
newsitem.headline: Romania to offer 1.25 trln lei in T-bills in May.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said on Thursday it would launch four issues of three-month treasury bills totalling 1.254 trillion lei to be placed through auctions next month.
The fixed-interest bills have a face value of 10 million lei each and will be offered through Dutch-style auctions with investors allowed to submit only competitive bids.
Auctions are scheduled two days before the T-bills issue date. A competitive bid must be for a minimum 100 million lei worth of bills.

On Tuesday, the ministry held the first auction for government papers under the new rules on securities trading approved earlier in April. The issue of 501 billion lei in 91-day T-bills was heavily oversubscribed with 18 banks entering bids offering an annual yield of 104 percent.
In the the past months, the Finance Ministry had issued mainly floating-rate bills with high-returning annual yields, which reached 232.38 percent for end-February bills.
